name: Tabletop helper
description: Game-master and player aids for tabletop and role-playing games on plain text and CSV files, with no game system built in. Roll dice expressions (2d6+3, 4d6kh3, 2d20kl1, 3d8dl1+1d4-2, one per line) with a seed so rolls can be repeated; Odds gives the exact probability table for each expression; Initiative turns a combatants CSV into an initiative order and a round tracker; Character sheet check tests a "Field: value" sheet for required fields, ability ranges and the point-buy table and budget you give; Notes index lists NPCs and locations by where they are mentioned in your campaign notes. Dice are fair pseudo-random chance and nothing predicts them. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Roll dice expressions
presets.description: A text file with one dice expression per line (2d6+3, 4d6kh3, d100 ...). Extra arguments: seed=42 repeats the same rolls, times=5 rolls each expression five times. The seed used is printed.

presets.label: Probability table
presets.description: Exact chance of every total for each dice expression (keep/drop included), with the mean and the chance of at least each total. Type target=15 in the extra arguments for the chance of 15 or more. Very large cases are sampled and labelled.

presets.label: Initiative order and tracker
presets.description: A CSV with name, bonus, hp, ac, team, count (count 3 makes Goblin 1-3, each rolled separately). Rolls d20 plus the bonus (die=12 for another die, seed=N to repeat) and writes the order and a round tracker.

presets.label: Character sheet check
presets.description: A sheet of "Field: value" lines. Extra arguments you define: require=name,class,level abilities=str,dex,con,int,wis,cha min=3 max=18 and, for point-buy, budget=27 costs=8:0,9:1,10:2,... (score:cost). No game rules are assumed.

presets.label: Campaign notes index (NPCs, locations)
presets.description: Notes in markdown (a file or a folder). Type with=ENTITIES.csv (name, type, aliases) in the extra arguments for a typed index; without it, terms in **bold** are used. Shows where and how often each is mentioned and who never appears.
